We ship several great investment products yearly, thus expanding our regulatory surface area with every new product.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We're investing in embedded engineers because we believe the path to a 10x improvement runs through engineers who <strong>work shoulder-to-shoulder with operators</strong>, not engineers who build solutions to spec from a backlog. Our 2026 company priority is to cut ops tickets per 1,000 transactions in half. You'll be a key part of getting us there.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2>What you'll do</h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Embed with enablement teams</strong> — Brokerage Operations, AML/Compliance Supervision, Trade Desk, Treasury, Account Operations, Margin Supervision — to deeply understand how the work gets done and where the friction lives.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Automate high-volume manual workflows end to end</strong>, from regulatory reporting (AML STR/LVCTR/EFTR, Form 1/CIRO, DTC asset segregation) to journal entries, reconciliations, collateral monitoring, brokerage liquidations, and complex registered-plan administration.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Advance our risk oversight</strong> for leveraged offerings by building automated alerts, managing liquidation processes, and daily reconciliations with external vendors.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Partner with the AI agentic workflows team</strong> to make sure what you build is accurate, secure, auditable, and reuses shared components rather than reinventing them.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Exercise judgment on what's the highest impact.</strong> You won't be handed a ticket backlog — you'll work with leadership on the Brokerage team, engineering managers, and with the operators themselves to decide what gets built.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Surface the invisible problems.</strong> Some of your most valuable output will be insight: pattern recognition across workflows that becomes input to regular R&amp;D planning.</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2>What we're looking for</h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Senior software engineer</strong> with strong full-stack range and comfort across data pipelines, internal tooling, and AI-augmented workflow automation.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>A genuine collaborator with non-engineers</strong> — you can sit in an ops standup, ask the right questions, build trust with compliance officers and traders, and translate what you hear into shippable solutions.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Bias for shipping in the weeds.</strong> You make judgment calls about what to fix without waiting for a PM to scope it. You close loops yourself.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Comfort with ambiguity.</strong> This role rewards engineers who can take a vague \"this workflow is painful\" and walk out with a concrete diagnosis, a path, and an outcome.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>A reuse-first mindset.</strong> You coordinate across embedded teams (AML, brokerage tooling, reliability) and integrate with what already exists rather than rebuilding it.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Entrepreneur mindset.</strong> You proactively identify what needs doing, take ownership, and drive solutions forward, thriving on autonomy rather than waiting for a predefined problem or plan.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Deep curiosity. </strong>You're the person who reads the docs before the meeting, digs into the \"why\" behind the business requirement, and learns a new domain because you genuinely want to understand how things work — not just what you need to ship.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>AI-first mindset. </strong>You leverage AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and solve problems more effectively. You have already evolved your workflow through AI and are eager to continue innovating.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Strong written communication.</strong> You'll regularly report to the Engineering and Brokerage leadership on what you're learning and where the next 10x opportunity is</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2>Bonus points</h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience in fintech, brokerage operations, regulated financial services, or capital markets infrastructure</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Familiarity with Oracle/Exadata/EBS, ledger systems, or large-scale internal tooling platforms</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">A track record of shipping AI-driven workflow automation in regulated environments</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience leading workstreams that spanned multiple teams or organizations, delivering impact without having direct authority over everyone involved.</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">If this resonates, we'd love to hear from you. We ship several great investment products yearly, thus expanding our regulatory surface area with every new product.\n\nWe're investing in embedded engineers because we believe the path to a 10x improvement runs through engineers who work shoulder-to-shoulder with operators, not engineers who build solutions to spec from a backlog. Our 2026 company priority is to cut ops tickets per 1,000 transactions in half. You won't be handed a ticket backlog — you'll work with leadership on the Brokerage team, engineering managers, and with the operators themselves to decide what gets built.\n\n - Surface the invisible problems. You proactively identify what needs doing, take ownership, and drive solutions forward, thriving on autonomy rather than waiting for a predefined problem or plan.\n\n - Deep curiosity. You're the person who reads the docs before the meeting, digs into the \"why\" behind the business requirement, and learns a new domain because you genuinely want to understand how things work — not just what you need to ship.\n\n - AI-first mindset. You leverage AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and solve problems more effectively. You have already evolved your workflow through AI and are eager to continue innovating.\n\n - Strong written communication. Read our <a target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" href=\"https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture\"><u>Culture Manual</u></a> and learn more about <a target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" href=\"https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers\"><u>how we work</u></a>.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2>About the team</h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We’re building a new <strong>AI-enabled adversarial testing capability</strong> whose mandate is simple but ambitious: <strong>find all the ways Wealthsimple can be exploited before our AI-enabled adversaries do</strong>. This group combines penetration testing, secure code analysis, and attack simulation R&amp;D to continuously probe Wealthsimple’s systems using a combination of automation, autonomous AI agents, and human expertise. If you want to build an automated, end-to-end clearbox pentesting/red teaming platform, this is the team doing it!</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You’ll join as an <strong>individual contributor</strong> on this team, reporting into the <strong>Manager, Application Security</strong>, working alongside a platform engineer, security researcher, and the application security team.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2>About the role</h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">As a <strong>Frontier AI Security Penetration Tester</strong>, you’ll be a hybrid builder and breaker:</p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Design and run<strong> automation-driven attack campaigns</strong> against Wealthsimple’s products and infrastructure including activities like:</p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Designing realistic AI attack scenarios that account for:</p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Attacker goals, initial access assumptions, and constraints.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Success criteria and clear boundaries for safety.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Wealthsimple-specific risks, design flaws, trust boundaries, and risk tolerance</p></li></ul></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Use and evolve our AI agents and tooling to:</p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Perform recon, vulnerability probing, confirmation, impact analysis, exploitation, and post-exploitation in safe environments.</p></li></ul></li></ul></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Help shape and improve the <strong>automated testing pipeline</strong>: how we model assets, orchestrate agents, run automated workflows, and turn noisy outputs into actionable findings. You’ll work closely with a platform engineer and a researcher to</p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">improve how scenarios and workflows are modeled and automated so we can automate the replay of promising attack paths.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">build and improve AI agents and tooling</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Propose and validate new tools or capabilities that unlock richer attack behavior</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Learn to use our native and in-house tooling to find more</p></li></ul></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Work across the stack with platform engineers, AppSec, and other security teams to make automated and AI adversarial testing a <strong>routine, high-signal part of our SDLC</strong>. This includes:</p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">reviewing AI-generated findings to separate high-impact vulnerabilities from noise and false positives.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Enhance proofs-of-concept into clear, reproducible steps for engineering teams and new automations</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Support remediation by pairing with engineers when needed and verifying that fixes address the root cause.</p></li></ul></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You’ll have substantial influence on the team’s roadmap through experimentation and R&amp;D.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2>People who will succeed in this role are</h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><em><strong>Courageously Ambitious - </strong></em>they enthusiastically tackle big audacious goals.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><em><strong>Deeply Human</strong></em> <em><strong>-</strong></em> they take responsibility for bringing the best out of themselves and others.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><em><strong>Problem Solvers - </strong></em>they have the ability and resilience to tackle complex issues, find common patterns, design solutions for scale, and see them through.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Enthusiastic Communicators</strong> - they capture and share learnings by default, and are always looking to implement suggestions for improvements and guardrails</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Embraces change and experimentation</strong> - treat campaigns and framework changes as experiments. Thoughtfully define hypotheses, evaluation criteria, and success metrics, then analyze outcomes and share results with the team to guide next iterations.</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2>Skills and Experience</h2><h3>Required</h3><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience building <strong>AI- or automation-assisted offensive security tools</strong>.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience (5+ years preferred) in offensive security testing domains like penetration testing, red teaming, threat hunting, or attack simulations in complex environments with a proven history of working cross-functionally with high functioning teams.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Strong technical cloud-native architectures (preferably AWS).</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Technical understanding of networks, endpoint, identity, cloud, encryption, data protection and application deployment stacks.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Knowledge of standard penetration testing methodologies, including NIST SP 800-115.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Familiarity with <strong>LLM- or agent-based systems</strong> (tool use/function calling, prompt design).</p></li></ul></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Comfort working with <strong>novel tools and ambiguity</strong>:</p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You’re already experimenting with AI agents and have always had a scale and automation-first mindset to testing and discovering new vulnerabilities.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You can turn open-ended problems into small, testable steps.</p></li></ul></li></ul><h2>Preferred but not When we do it well, the whole company moves faster and ships with more confidence.\n\nYou'll join one of our Platform teams and take ownership of significant pieces of the developer experience. You'll work hands-on across the full lifecycle: designing, building, shipping, and operating the systems engineers depend on every day. You'll lead projects end-to-end, partner with the teams that use what you build, and grow your influence beyond your immediate team as you go. This job posting covers two distinct areas:\n\n - Platform Engineering: You build the systems that enable engineers to build, ship, and operate software reliably and efficiently, including developer platforms, internal tooling, CI/CD and software delivery systems, cloud infrastructure and service frameworks, reliability and observability tooling, and large-scale distributed systems. The focus is on improving developer productivity, system reliability, and software delivery speed.\n\n - Data Platforms: You build the infrastructure that powers data, analytics, and machine learning across the company, including data ingestion pipelines and orchestration, large-scale data warehousing, streaming and batch processing systems, data modeling, quality and governance, and analytics enablement. The focus is on delivering trusted, scalable, and high-quality data systems.\n\n \n\n\nIN ONE THESE ROLES YOU'LL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO:\n\n - Design and build production-grade distributed systems\n\n - You'll experiment with new workflows, share what works, and help establish patterns that the rest of the team can build on.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Drive process and engineering excellence.</strong> Senior engineers on our team don't just ship features, they identify what's slowing the team down and fix it. Our responsibilities are to:</p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Build and maintain infrastructure to host and serve open-source LLMs reliably on cloud/GPU systems.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Implement intelligent model-routing frameworks to optimize performance, cost, and latency.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Develop evaluation and benchmarking tooling (Evals) to test, validate, and compare model performance across use cases.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Set the technical direction for operating scalable LLM infrastructure company-wide.</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>The Role</strong></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">As a Senior Software Engineer on the ML Infrastructure team, you will design and implement the core backend and infrastructure powering our AI systems. Vendor & Tooling Strategy: Direct build vs. buy vs. broker decisions across the stack, maximizing value from tools like Datadog while controlling costs and reducing lock-in.\n\n - Hands-On Architecture: Stay in the code when needed to unblock teams, prototype new approaches, and review complex designs.\n\n\nWHAT YOU BRING\n\n - Platform & Standards: Track record of shipping developer SDKs/libraries and applying OpenTelemetry (or equivalent) alongside SLI/SLO design.\n\n - Strategic & Technical Leadership: Ability to set a vision, run experimental pilots, stay hands-on with architecture, and influence across teams.\n\n - We do this by brokering tools and patterns into golden paths that accelerate best practices, and by connecting teams to business impact through SLOs, user flows, and customer experience signals. We instrument on open standards so that switching costs are a configuration change rather than a rewrite, we optimize for the questions engineers did not anticipate rather than for pre-built dashboards, and we design for a world where both humans and AI agents investigate production through fast, high-cardinality data.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">As the Staff Software Engineer on this team, you are the deepest technical builder and the person who sets the technical bar. You design the foundations, write the code that matters most, and raise the engineering quality of everyone around you.</p><h3><strong>In this role you'll have the opportunity to:</strong></h3><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Build the Event Foundation:</strong> Own the architecture for wide-event data models, high-cardinality storage, and high-throughput ingestion and query pipelines (columnar/streaming).</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Craft SDKs &amp; Golden Paths:</strong> Design, ship, and drive adoption for telemetry libraries and SDKs that make rich instrumentation the path of least resistance.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Set Technical Standards:</strong> Define instrumentation conventions, naming, tagging, sampling, and OpenTelemetry standards so humans and machines speak one language.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Enable AI Agents in Production:</strong> Build fast query foundations and access patterns (e.g., Model Context Protocol / MCP) that allow AI agents to investigate incidents and verify changes alongside engineers.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Build Fast with AI:</strong> Leverage modern AI tools (like Claude Code) to prototype, navigate complex systems, and help elevate the team’s AI-assisted workflows.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Navigate Ambiguity:</strong> Dive into unfamiliar codebases to deliver significant, well-reasoned, high-impact changes safely.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Experiment &amp; Scale:</strong> Pilot new approaches with select teams, measure impact, and scale what works before committing broadly.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Raise the Technical Bar:</strong> Mentor senior engineers, review complex architecture, and lead cross-team technical initiatives through influence.</p></li></ul><h3><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></h3><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>8+ Years in Software Engineering:</strong> Strong software background (building platforms as software) rather than pure Ops/SysAdmin.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Multi-Language Coder:</strong> Current, hands-on experience writing production code in multiple languages (e.g., Kotlin, Ruby).</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Proven Telemetry Experience:</strong> Prior success building telemetry platforms, ingestion pipelines, and developer-facing SDKs.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Event &amp; Scale Mastery:</strong> Deep understanding of wide structured events, streaming/columnar backends, cardinality, sampling, and context propagation.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Open Standards Expert:</strong> Hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry (or equivalent) and designing SLIs/SLOs.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>System Navigator:</strong> Ability to quickly map out, safely refactor, and impact complex, ambiguous codebases you didn't originally build.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>AI-Fluent Developer:</strong> Daily proficiency with AI tools (like Claude Code) to move faster while maintaining high quality standards.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Strong Influencer:</strong> Exceptional communication skills to partner with cross-functional engineering teams and explain complex tradeoffs clearly.</p></li></ul><h3><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h3><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience in fintech or regulated environments.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Hands-on experience with ClickHouse or columnar stores.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Exposure to Kubernetes and progressive delivery tools (e.g., Argo Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.\n\n\n\nThe Anti-Money Laundering (AML) team is responsible for the detection, response, and mitigation of inherent and residual money laundering and terrorist financing risks. As a Team Lead, you’ll lead a team of Analysts focused on monitoring and investigating fiat and cryptocurrency transactions and risks. You'll drive proactive workflow improvements, navigate emerging AML typologies, and support your team’s continuous learning, helping set the standard for digital asset financial crime controls in Canada.\n\n\n\n\nIN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:\n\n\n\n\n - Lead and develop a team of AML analysts, supporting their growth through coaching, regular 1:1s, feedback, and career conversations.\n\n - Set expectations and prioritization: communicate team and company goals, help analysts manage their workload, and adapt to shifting priorities.\n\n - Review and approve high-priority or complex investigations, ensuring adherence to internal AML policies and regulatory standards.\n\n - Champion operational excellence by monitoring team metrics (case turnaround, QA scores), analyzing trends, and acting on process or workflow gaps.\n\n - Utilize and help train the team on blockchain analytics tools, and support analysts in escalation and technical troubleshooting.\n\n - Act as a subject matter expert in financial crime (traditional fiat and/or cryptocurrency), staying up-to-date on typologies, regulatory changes, and emerging risks.\n\n - Drive improvement and innovation by proposing and piloting enhancements to alerts, casework, and overall risk strategy for fiat and crypto activity.\n\n - Ensure clear communication with stakeholders: giving proactive updates, escalating issues, and following through to resolution.\n\n - Foster a learning culture by leading regular knowledge-sharing or calibration sessions, supporting ongoing training, and spotlighting growth opportunities.\n   \n   \n\n\nWHAT DOES THE IDEAL CANDIDATE LOOK LIKE?\n\n - A hands-on leader and coach: strong at guiding others, giving feedback, and helping people stretch into new skills.\n\n - Passionate about AML: in-depth understanding of fiat and/or digital asset transaction monitoring, typologies, and regulatory best practices.\n\n - Accountable for results: data-driven, able to track and explain team performance, and agile in addressing emerging bottlenecks.\n\n - Comfortable with ambiguity and change: pro-actively finds improvement opportunities and leads the team through new workflows, system rollouts, or policy changes.\n\n - A great communicator: skilled at translating complex findings into plain language, and keeping both analysts and management informed.\n\n - Resilient and resourceful: sees challenges as chances to grow, and acts as a calm anchor in fast-evolving or high-pressure situations.\n\n\n\n\nQUALIFICATIONS\n\n - 4+ years of experience in AML/CTF, with 2+ years of hands-on crypto AML experience (e.g., at a crypto exchange, blockchain analytics provider, or fintech offering digital assets).\n\n - 1-2+ years in a team leadership role, coaching or managing direct reports in an operational environment.\n\n - Subject-matter expertise in AML controls, typologies, and compliance frameworks (FATF, FINTRAC, etc.).\n\n - Direct experience conducting investigations and preparing, filing, and reviewing Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs), Large Virtual Currency Transaction Reports (LVCTR), Electronic Funds Transfer Reports (EFTR), and other regulatory reports.\n\n - Strong operational rigor: proven track record of meeting SLAs, overseeing QA, and driving process improvements.\n\n - Proficient with crypto on-chain analytics tools (e.g., Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic).\n\n - Excellent written and verbal communication skills.\n\n\n\n\nNICE TO HAVES\n\n - Certifications in Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic, or financial crime designations (e.g., CAMS, CFE, CFCS).\n\n - Experience at a regulated crypto exchange or blockchain analytics firm.\n\n\n\n\nWHY WEALTHSIMPLE?\n\n🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance\n\n📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business\n\n🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year\n\n✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year\n\n👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS\n\n🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.\n\n\n\n\nICYMI\n\nTechnology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.\n\n\n\nInclusion Statement: We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well. This is not a features-on-top-of-a-BaaS role. We're building card infrastructure in-house, and the person we hire will be able to say they built it.\n\nYou'll bring strong technical judgment, a bias toward action, and a deep sense of ownership. You'll work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to turn complex, high-stakes problems into simple, reliable experiences for millions of Canadians.\n\n\n\n\nWHAT YOU'LL DO\n\n - Shape and own greenfield work in a space that's still early for Wealthsimple — our card program is still in its early years and there's significant greenfield building ahead; if you've built something from scratch before, that experience will go far here\n\n - Own complex, end-to-end projects across the card stack — from technical design through implementation, launch, and iteration\n\n - Build and improve the backend systems that power our card products, with a focus on reliability, performance, and correctness\n\n - Work on core card infrastructure: card issuance, tokenization, authorization flows, BIN management, transaction processing, card lifecycle management, and dispute infrastructure\n\n - Make thoughtful architectural decisions and help the team balance speed, quality, and scale — influence what we build, how we build it, and where we go next\n\n - Partner closely with Product and Design to clarify goals, surface trade-offs, and deliver outcomes — not just features\n\n - Build with the reliability and observability standards that card journeys demand — a declined tap or a poorly handled dispute is felt immediately by our members\n\n - Leverage AI-centric workflows to ship faster and safer — we invest heavily in AI tooling and expect senior engineers to push the frontier of how we use these tools\n\n - Raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, documentation, pairing, and mentorship\n\n - Help create a team culture where people communicate clearly, learn quickly, and take ownership together\n\n \n \n\n\nWHAT YOU BRING\n\n - 5+ years of professional software engineering experience and a track record of shipping production-grade systems that real users depend on\n\n - Experience building and owning backend systems in a payments, card, or financial services environment — ideally with direct exposure to card issuance, authorization, payment rails, or card lifecycle management\n\n - Strong backend engineering fundamentals — you understand how money moves, how systems fail, and how to build for correctness at scale\n\n - A maker-owner mindset: you're looking for a place to plant a flag, take ownership of a growing domain, and shape it over time — motivated by building the best card program in Canada, not just shipping the next ticket\n\n - Comfort with ambiguity and greenfield work — you've built something from 0→1 before and thrive in an environment where not everything is defined yet\n\n - An AI-first development workflow that doesn't compromise on rigour — you've moved beyond AI as autocomplete into genuinely agentic workflows, and bring the engineering judgment to know when the model is wrong\n\n - Product judgment: you care about the member problem, can simplify complexity, and know when to iterate versus when to invest for the long term\n\n - The ability to navigate ambiguity, define a path forward, and bring others along through clear written and verbal communication\n\n - Technical leadership and mentorship instincts — you raise the bar through your code, your reviews, your design documents, and the way you support your teammates\n\n - A collaborative, low-ego approach to engineering and a willingness to give and receive candid feedback\n\n \n \n\n\nNICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE\n\n - Experience working directly with card networks or card processors — on either side of the integration\n\n - Experience building card infrastructure in-house rather than on top of a BaaS platform\n\n - Within that team, our Workforce Management function is the engine that keeps client support running at scale, forecasting demand, scheduling the right people at the right times, and making sure we can deliver fast, reliable experiences no matter what's happening in the business. We're a team that takes operational excellence seriously, and we're now investing in the technical capability to make WFM smarter, faster, and more scalable than it's ever been. If you want to build the systems that power a world-class contact centre, this is where that work happens.</p><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\"> </div><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\"> </div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Workforce management at scale is a hard problem, and right now, too much of how we solve it relies on manual effort that doesn't scale with Wealthsimple's growth. This role exists to change that. You'll own the technical foundation of our WFM function: building AI agents to automate the heavy lift, developing forecasting and scheduling models that help us stay ahead of demand, and shaping the platform decisions that determine what's possible. You'll also shape how the WFM function thinks about technology, setting direction, raising the technical bar, and bringing the analyst team along with you.</p><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\"> </div><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\"> </div><h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Build AI agents that automate manual, labour-intensive WFM tasks, reducing human intervention and freeing the team to focus on higher-value work</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Develop forecasting and scheduling models and real-time recommendation engines that improve how we anticipate and respond to demand at scale</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Drive the technical evaluation and co-ownership of WFM platform decisions, including our current tooling assessment, with a focus on platforms that support API-based customization and automation</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Work closely with data and engineering teams to understand and leverage existing data pipelines and architecture, without owning them directly</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Set the technical direction for WFM automation and tooling, and bring the analyst team and cross-functional partners along through hands-on mentorship and clear, accessible documentation</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Act as the technical voice for the WFM function in cross-org planning and roadmapping discussions</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Identify opportunities to decouple team headcount growth from company growth, building systems that scale without requiring proportional increases in staffing.</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You understand WFM at a systems level, not just the workflows, but the logic underneath them, and you use that understanding to build things that actually work in production</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You're a builder at heart; you're not satisfied with workarounds when the right solution is an automated one</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You're comfortable owning decisions with real operational stakes, and you bring enough domain knowledge to make a compelling case when it matters</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You can move between deep technical work and clear communication with non-technical partners without losing anything in translation</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You're curious about the problem space, not just the tools, you want to understand why something breaks, not just fix it</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You're comfortable leading through influence, you don't need a formal mandate to shape how and real-time routing or recommendation engines using large-scale operational datasets.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>3+ years of production-grade AI &amp; Automation workflow automation at enterprise scale.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Proven track record of writing production code against REST APIs, managing webhooks, and interacting directly with data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) to build custom middleware between CRM, WFM, and ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce, Verint).</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Demonstrated experience translating high-level business strategy into technical system design, while mentoring junior specialists and establishing operational guardrails for We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and business leaders to design experiments, build models, and surface insights that shape what we ship.</p><h3><strong>Our Teams:</strong></h3><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Agentic Analytics &amp; Context Engineering</strong></p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Banking &amp; AI Products DSE</strong></p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Growth &amp; Investing Data Science</strong></p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Enablement Data Science</strong></p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Credit Analytics</strong></p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Fraud &amp; AML Countermeasures</strong></p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Together, these teams cover the full range of our data work, from building the data infrastructure and tooling that power the business, to partnering directly with banking, growth, and investing product teams, to bringing decision science to our operational and financial backbone, to owning the analytics and machine learning behind credit and fraud risk. Wherever you land, you'll be working with real production data to help shape decisions that directly impact millions of clients.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Tech stack:</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Python-first environment with Pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy, and Jupyter</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">SQL for data access and manipulation across large, production datasets</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Statistical foundations across both frequentist and Bayesian approaches</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Machine learning toolkit spanning regression, decision trees, and beyond</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experimentation infrastructure for A/B testing and causal inference at scale</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2><strong>Who We're Looking For</strong></h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Take ownership without being asked. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.\n\n\n\nWe're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.\n\n\n\n\nABOUT THE TEAM\n\nThe tax team sits inside Finance and looks after Wealthsimple's own corporate tax position. We're deliberately building out specialist tax functions: one lane owns direct tax, another owns transfer pricing and international tax. The team is small, the entity group isn't, and we're putting in place the review and documentation discipline that investor-grade reporting depends on. If you'd rather set a technical standard than inherit one, this is a good moment to join.\n\n\n\n\nABOUT THE ROLE\n\nReporting to the Director of Tax, you'll own the direct tax lane: our income tax provision, corporate compliance, deferred tax attribute tracking, corporate tax forecasting, and the technical positions behind them. Indirect tax and transfer pricing sit with other specialists, so you can go deep rather than wide.\n\n\n\n\nIN THIS ROLE YOU'LL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO:\n\n - Prepare or review the income tax provision each month, quarter, and year, covering current and deferred tax, the effective tax rate reconciliation, provision-to-return true-ups, and tax account reconciliations.\n\n - Set the technical standard for direct tax: what gets independently recalculated, what can be accepted on the preparer's support, and what evidence a review leaves behind. You'll shape the workpapers, registers and review workflow that carry that standard, including where AI/automation takes on the assembly so your time goes to judgment\n\n - Analyze and document any new and significant and/or complex tax  positions, from recognition and recoverability of deferred tax assets to attributes and loss pools through entity changes, EIFEL restrictions, and uncertain treatments under IFRIC 23. Refresh positions on an annual basis.Review http://basis.Review T2 and provincial corporate income tax returns across the entity group, along with instalments, elections and information returns, keep the compliance calendar current, and follow through with true-ups to returns and notices of assessments Investigate and resolve discrepancies in assessment and refund amounts by proactively following up with tax authorities and other internal tax function areas\n\n - Ensure tax return working papers are prepared in an audit-ready manner, with clear substantiation and source documents maintained within tax ownership to support positions taken\n\n - Produce and upkeep entity level tax memos for each legal entity which outlines the business operations, tax adjustments and basis of treatment that links back to the relevant Income Tax Act or Regulation sections\n\n - Lead our direct tax audit support: the standing file, the schedules authorities ask for, and the technical responses that go back to the CRA and Revenu Québec\n\n - Ensure special tax elections/waivers for tax exemptions or deferrals are filed on time, in the appropriate method and evidence retained for audit defence\n\n - Assist Tax Director in advising the business on the direct tax consequences of transactions, entity changes, and reorganisations\n\n\nSKILLS YOU BRING:\n\n - CPA designation, with deep Canadian corporate income tax knowledge and hands-on provision experience under IFRS and IAS 12: current and deferred tax, the effective tax rate reconciliation, tax forecasting,and provision-to-return true-ups\n\n - Judgment on recognition and recoverability of deferred tax assets, plus experience with tax attributes and loss pools\n\n - T2 and provincial corporate income tax compliance across a multi-entity group\n\n - A track record of reviewing work prepared by other people. You've written review notes, cleared them, and decided when something was ready to release. Technical writing that lands: you can frame an issue, reach a defensible position, document the basis, and explain the conclusion to someone who doesn't do tax\n\n\nNICE TO HAVE:\n\n - In-Depth Tax Program or an equivalent Canadian tax specialisation\n\n - Experience with CRA or provincial audits and correspondence\n\n - Experience directing external tax advisors rather than receiving output\n\n - Financial services, fintech, or another regulated multi-entity environment, and familiarity with Taxprep, NetSuite, Taxnet Pro or comparable tools\n\n\nWHO YOU ARE:\n\nYou take active ownership of direct tax, monitor changes internally (new product and line of business) and externally (new tax legislations and CRA administrative positions).You review by risk, not by rote: you know what deserves an independent recalculation and what doesn't, and you can explain the difference. You hold a technical line without making it personal, so your review notes read as help rather than a verdict on someone's competence.\n\n\n\nYou document a position as you reach it, so the conclusion stands on its own later. You're comfortable with data and processes we're still sharpening, and you use AI where it earns its place and are clear about where it doesn't. You wouldn't let a model form a judgment you'd have to defend.\n\n\n\n\nWHY WEALTHSIMPLE?\n\n🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance\n\n📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business\n\n🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year\n\n✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year\n\n👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS\n\n🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. Within Operations, the Credit Risk team owns the models, frameworks, and day-to-day execution that keep Wealthsimple's brokerage business running soundly — across margin, delinquency, and dynamic risk reporting. We're a high-ownership team that works closely with Product, Finance, and the business to close gaps, reduce friction, and build for scale. If you take risk seriously and want your work to have a direct impact on how millions of Canadians experience their finances, you'll feel at home here.</p><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\"> </div><h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We manage billions of dollars on behalf of millions of Canadians, and doing that well means having people who understand not just what a model says — but whether it's saying something meaningful. This is a risk quant role in the true sense: you'll own the development, maintenance, and methodology of the models our teams depend on to make consequential decisions every day. You'll work across margin, stress testing, and capital impact modelling in a CIRO-regulated environment, and you'll be the person who knows when something is off and can fix it.</p><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\"> </div><h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Own the development, testing, and ongoing maintenance of quantitative risk models, including VaR, SVaR, broad-based stress testing, and single-stock stress testing — updating them as market conditions and regulatory requirements evolve</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Write and maintain clear methodology documentation for every model used in day-to-day stakeholder decisions, so the teams consuming your outputs understand what they're working with</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Apply deep knowledge of CIRO 5000 margin rules to model how margin requirements and capital would be impacted under a range of stressed conditions</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Develop production-quality code across multiple programming languages to build, maintain, and improve model infrastructure</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Work cross-functionally with margin, delinquency, and dynamic risk reporting teams to support risk-cognizant decision-making — translating complex model outputs into clear, actionable guidance</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Identify and flag model performance issues proactively, including cases where outputs may be inaccurate or non-meaningful given current market conditions</p></li></ul><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\"> </div><h3><strong>Skills you bring</strong></h3><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">7 to 10 years of experience in a quantitative risk or quantitative analytics role within financial services, preferably in a CIRO-regulated brokerage environment</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Genuine hands-on model development experience across stress testing methodologies including VaR, SVaR, broad-based stress testing, and single-stock stress testing — not just model consumption</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Deep knowledge of markets, trading instruments, and valuation principles across equities, options, futures, and fixed income</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Deep understanding of CIRO 5000 margin rules and the ability to model how margin requirements and capital would be impacted under stressed conditions</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Expert-level proficiency in at least one quantitative programming language (Python, R, or similar), with demonstrated ability to develop production-quality code</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Strong written communication skills, including the ability to produce clear methodology documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Ability to work independently on complex technical problems and deliver under tight deadlines without requiring hands-on management We're a high-ownership team that works closely with Product, Finance, and the business to close gaps, reduce friction, and build for scale. You'll work across margin, stress testing, and capital impact modelling in a CIRO-regulated environment, and you'll be the person who knows when something is off and can fix it.\n\n \n\n\nWHAT YOU'LL DO\n\n - Develop production-quality code across multiple programming languages to build, maintain, and improve model infrastructure\n\n - Work cross-functionally with margin, delinquency, and dynamic risk reporting teams to support risk-cognizant decision-making — translating complex model outputs into clear, actionable guidance\n\n - You won't rely on separate data engineering teams to productionize your work: <strong>you will build, containerize, test, and deploy your own production-grade quantitative code</strong>, while maintaining pipelines for model drift, data failures, and numerical anomalies. Within Operations, the Credit Risk team owns the models, frameworks, and day-to-day execution that keep Wealthsimple's brokerage business running soundly — across margin, delinquency, and dynamic risk reporting. We're a high-ownership team that works closely with Product, Finance, and the business to close gaps, reduce friction, and build for scale. If you take risk seriously and want your work to have a direct impact on how millions of Canadians experience their finances, you'll feel at home here.\n\n\nABOUT THE ROLE\n\nThis is a hands-on Quantitative Risk Lead role to own end-to-end model development, deploy risk microservices, and manage production CI/CD execution pipelines. You won't rely on separate data engineering teams to productionize your work: you will build, containerize, test, and deploy your own production-grade quantitative code, while maintaining pipelines for model drift, data failures, and numerical anomalies. You will also lead the quantitative architecture for CIRO 5000 margin rules, stress testing, and VaR engines.\n\nThis role operates as a hybrid function: part Quantitative Financial Engineering, part Software Engineering/Data Science. \n\n\nKEY RESPONSIBILITIES\n\n - Quantitative Model Development: Design, code, and backtest Monte Carlo, Stressed, Historical, and Parametric VaR engines, CVaR, and multi-factor stress testing models.\n\n - Derivatives Valuation & Pricing: Implement options pricing models (Black-Scholes-Merton, Binomial Trees), greeks execution engines, and shock scenarios across equities, options, futures, and fixed income.\n\n - CIRO 5000 Regulatory Modeling: Operationalize CIRO 5000 margin rules into programmatic engines to compute stressed margin requirements, concentration haircuts, and firm capital impacts.\n\n - Software Engineering & Pipelines: Write modular Python code (NumPy, Pandas, Polars, SciPy) and construct optimized SQL/dbt data pipelines for massive financial time-series datasets.\n\n - CI/CD & Production Operations: Build and deploy Dockerized microservices via CI/CD workflows. Write unit tests (pytest), diagnose out-of-memory errors, and repair pipeline failures in real time.\n\n - Governance & Leadership: Author technical methodology documentation for regulators and internal audit, maintain model registries (e.g., MLflow), and mentor/conduct code reviews for junior quants.\n\n\nREQUIREMENTS & TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS\n\n - Experience: 7–10+ years of quantitative development experience in financial services, preferably within a CIRO-regulated brokerage.\n\n - Quantitative Finance: Expert knowledge of options pricing, volatility surfaces (SABR, SVI), market risk metrics, and CIRO 5000 margin/capital requirements.\n\n - Software Engineering: Production experience with modern software engineering: Git, containerization (Docker), async processing, REST APIs (FastAPI), and testing frameworks (pytest).\n\n - Data Stack: Strong SQL mastery and hands-on experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL) and distributed data tools.\n\n - CI/CD & Cloud: Experience deploying models to cloud environments (AWS/GCP) via automated build and test pipelines.\n\n - Leadership: Proven ability to lead technical projects, direct a small team, and manage backlog priorities.\n\n\nTECH STACK\n\n - Languages: Python, R, SQL\n\n - Data & Storage: Snowflake, PostgreSQL, dbt\n\n - DevOps & Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Airflow/Prefect\n\n - Frameworks & Testing: pytest, FastAPI, MLflow\n\n\nNICE TO HAVE\n\n - Education & Credentials: Master’s or Ph.D. in a quantitative field (Financial Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Math). Read our <a target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" href=\"https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture\"><u>Culture Manual</u></a> and learn more about <a target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" href=\"https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers\"><u>how we work</u></a>.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h1><strong>Rotational Programs @ Wealthsimple</strong></h1><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Location:</strong> Toronto, Hybrid</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Our marketing teams are offering a 12 month Early Talent rotational program starting in January 2027. They’re designed for co-op students, non-co-op students, and recent graduates who are ready to ship impactful work. You'll join a high-performing team where you'll contribute to projects that are fundamentally changing how Canadians manage their money. We're committed to your growth, providing the mentorship and community you need to deepen your craft and leave better than you arrived.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Our Early Talent program operates on a <strong>hybrid </strong>model where our early talent come into office on <strong>Wednesdays and Thursdays.</strong> We’ll also get together for key moments like team gatherings, early talent events, and other IRL moments that matter.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>This posting covers two roles: Growth Marketing</strong> and <strong>Product and Client Marketing</strong>. Please select your preference in the application form for the one that best fits your interests.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2></h2><h1><strong>Product and Client Marketing</strong></h1><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2>About the team</h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Wealthsimple's Product &amp; Client Marketing team is outcome-obsessed. We start with the business problem and work backwards to the marketing tactics, never the other way around. We're the connective tissue between Product, Sales, and Marketing, and we take full ownership of cross-functional work so our products and content get the attention they deserve. The team is made up of product marketers, content strategists, and the people who own how clients hear from us in the app. We work across 4 teams: Product Marketing for Investing and Banking, Product Engagement, and Content Marketing.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2>About the role</h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This is a 12-month program, not a summer job. You'll join the Product &amp; Client Marketing stream and spend the year in roughly 6 month rotations across two of our four teams:</p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Investing product marketing. </strong>Go-to-market for everything people invest in with us, from self-directed accounts to managed portfolios to private markets. Positioning, launch plans, and the client research behind both.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Banking product marketing.</strong> Go-to-market for the products people use every day: chequing, the Wealthsimple credit card, and lending.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Product Engagement. </strong>The in-app and email communications that take someone from \"I signed up\" to \"I use this for everything.\" Who gets a message, what it says, and what happened after it went out.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Content Marketing.</strong> Our content strategy, including educational resources and organic growth channels like <a target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" href=\"https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/learn\"><u>Wealthsimple Learn</u></a>.</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We'll match you to your first rotation based on what you're already good at and what projects are ready to go when you start. We'll pick the second one together, partway through the year, based on where you're strongest and what you want to get better at.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2>In this role, you'll have the opportunity to:</h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Own a real piece of a launch. A channel, a campaign flow, a set of assets, a section of a go-to-market plan. You'll run it day to day. Your manager reviews and QAs the work, but won't be telling you what to do next.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Write things (potentially millions of) clients actually read. Product copy, in-app messages, campaign emails, educational content. Drafted against a brief, edited hard, shipped.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Learn the products cold. By the end of a rotation you should be able to explain any product on your team in plain language, explain how it works underneath, and say why someone would pick us over the alternative.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Pull your own numbers. Get comfortable in our data and AI tools, report on how your work performed, and bring a recommendation for what to do next. Not just the chart.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Build a hard technical skill using our messaging platform, as well as HTML and CSS for email. These are skills you take with you: the tools we use are the tools most companies use.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Ideate &amp; experiment on lifecycle and cross-sell strategies to drive product engagement and adoption within Wealthsimple’s product ecosystem.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Leave something behind. Every rotation should end with work that outlasts you, and a handover clear enough that the next person can run it.</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h1><strong>Growth Marketing</strong></h1><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2>About the team</h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Wealthsimple's Growth Marketing team owns how people find us, and what happens after they do. We buy and earn attention across the channels where Canadians actually spend their time, then build the communications that turn a new signup into someone who uses Wealthsimple for everything. The team is made up of performance marketers, influencer and partnerships leads, and lifecycle marketers who live in the data and the details. We work across 3 teams: Lifecycle Marketing, User Acquisition, and Influencer Marketing.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2>About the role</h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This is a 12-month program, not a summer job. You'll join the Growth Marketing stream and spend the year in 2 rotations of roughly 6 months each, across our 3 teams:</p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Lifecycle Marketing.</strong> The emails, push notifications, and in-app messages that reach millions of clients. This is the most technical work on the team: audience logic, testing, QA, and a lot of time inside our messaging platform.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>User Acquisition.</strong> Paid performance marketing across channels like Meta and Snap. Building campaigns, watching them daily, and figuring out what to change when the numbers move.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Influencer Marketing. </strong>The creators and partners who introduce Wealthsimple to people who've never heard of us. Sourcing, briefing, and measuring whether any of it worked.</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We'll match you to your first rotation based on what you're already good at and what projects are ready to go when you start. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our <a target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" href=\"https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture\"><u>Culture Manual</u></a> and learn more about <a target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" href=\"https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers\"><u>how we work</u></a>.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The Client Tax team helps make investing simple, reliable, and compliant for Wealthsimple clients. We lead the systems, processes, controls, and reporting that support tax slips, registered accounts, client statements, withholding, and related regulatory obligations across our growing brokerage business.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You’ll lead Wealthsimple’s client tax function across brokerage products and regulated entities, including the people and team capabilities required to deliver the mandate. You’ll be accountable for accurate, timely, and scalable client tax reporting, while building the controls, systems, and operating practices needed to support continued product and client growth. You’ll act as a senior partner to CXO, Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Legal, and Finance, translating complex client tax and regulatory requirements into product design advice with clear decisions and reliable execution. A key part of the role is working closely with CXO to ensure reporting processes, internal &amp; external communications, and issue resolution deliver a clear and reliable client experience.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2><strong>In this role you'll have the opportunity to:</strong></h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Lead the strategy, operating model, and execution of Wealthsimple’s client tax operating function across Canadian and applicable U.S. requirements.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Own the end-to-end delivery of client tax slips, registered-account reporting, client statements, and related regulatory filings, including readiness, controls, quality assurance, amendments, and regulator communications.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Establish and maintain robust governance for QI, FATCA, CRS, non-resident withholding, and client reporting obligations, ensuring risks and regulatory gaps are identified and addressed.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Trusted advisor and partner to CXO, Product, Engineering, and Operations leaders on new-product client tax treatment and reporting implications, reporting logic, data quality, system requirements, testing, automation, scalable process design, and client-impacting issue resolution, excluding any corporate and sales tax implications.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Lead, coach, and develop the Client Tax team, including setting team priorities, hiring and onboarding, performance management, career development, and standards for accuracy, timeliness, escalation management, client outcomes, and audit readiness.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Implement AI and automation strategies to create significant operational efficiencies and leverage to support our ambition growth and scaling.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Provide clear technical research, recommendations, and executive-level communication on tax reporting issues, regulatory change, control environments, and investment priorities.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p></li></ul><h2><strong>Skills you bring:</strong></h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">8+ years of progressive experience in client tax reporting, financial services tax, brokerage operations, regulatory reporting, or a related function, including significant experience directly leading and developing people.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Deep knowledge of Canadian brokerage tax reporting and registered-account requirements, including relevant CRA, Revenu Québec, and applicable U.S. reporting obligations.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience with QI, FATCA, CRS, withholding tax, client statements, book-of-record data, and the control requirements associated with high-volume regulated reporting.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">A track record of leading cross-functional programs involving Product, CXO,  Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Legal, and external stakeholders.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Strong analytical, communication, and judgment skills, with the ability to turn complex regulatory requirements into strategic product design and practical operating decisions.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p></li></ul><h2><strong>Nice to have:</strong></h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">CPA designation or equivalent professional qualification.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">In-Depth Tax Program or an equivalent Canadian tax specialisation</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience with CIRO/CRM2/CRM3 reporting, fintech, digital brokerage, or high-growth financial-services environments.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience scaling reporting through automation, modern data tooling, and operational-control frameworks.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience in a Big Four or national accounting firm, or a comparable advisory environment.</p><p The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. We lead the systems, processes, controls, and reporting that support tax slips, registered accounts, client statements, withholding, and related regulatory obligations across our growing brokerage business.\n\n\n\n\nABOUT THE ROLE\n\nYou’ll lead Wealthsimple’s client tax function across brokerage products and regulated entities, including the people and team capabilities required to deliver the mandate. You’ll be accountable for accurate, timely, and scalable client tax reporting, while building the controls, systems, and operating practices needed to support continued product and client growth. You’ll act as a senior partner to CXO, Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Legal, and Finance, translating complex client tax and regulatory requirements into product design advice with clear decisions and reliable execution. A key part of the role is working closely with CXO to ensure reporting processes, internal & external communications, and issue resolution deliver a clear and reliable client experience.\n\n\n\n\nIN THIS ROLE YOU'LL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO:\n\n - Lead the strategy, operating model, and execution of Wealthsimple’s client tax operating function across Canadian and applicable U.S. requirements.\n\n - Own the end-to-end delivery of client tax slips, registered-account reporting, client statements, and related regulatory filings, including readiness, controls, quality assurance, amendments, and regulator communications.\n\n - Establish and maintain robust governance for QI, FATCA, CRS, non-resident withholding, and client reporting obligations, ensuring risks and regulatory gaps are identified and addressed.\n\n - Trusted advisor and partner to CXO, Product, Engineering, and Operations leaders on new-product client tax treatment and reporting implications, reporting logic, data quality, system requirements, testing, automation, scalable process design, and client-impacting issue resolution, excluding any corporate and sales tax implications.\n\n - Lead, coach, and develop the Client Tax team, including setting team priorities, hiring and onboarding, performance management, career development, and standards for accuracy, timeliness, escalation management, client outcomes, and audit readiness.\n\n - Implement AI and automation strategies to create significant operational efficiencies and leverage to support our ambition growth and scaling.\n\n - Provide clear technical research, recommendations, and executive-level communication on tax reporting issues, regulatory change, control environments, and investment priorities.\n   \n   \n\n\nSKILLS YOU BRING:\n\n - 8+ years of progressive experience in client tax reporting, financial services tax, brokerage operations, regulatory reporting, or a related function, including significant experience directly leading and developing people.\n\n - Deep knowledge of Canadian brokerage tax reporting and registered-account requirements, including relevant CRA, Revenu Québec, and applicable U.S. reporting obligations.\n\n - Experience with QI, FATCA, CRS, withholding tax, client statements, book-of-record data, and the control requirements associated with high-volume regulated reporting.\n\n - A track record of leading cross-functional programs involving Product, CXO,  Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Legal, and external stakeholders.\n\n - Strong analytical, communication, and judgment skills, with the ability to turn complex regulatory requirements into strategic product design and practical operating decisions.\n   \n   \n\n\nNICE TO HAVE:\n\n - CPA designation or equivalent professional qualification.\n\n - In-Depth Tax Program or an equivalent Canadian tax specialisation\n\n - Experience with CIRO/CRM2/CRM3 reporting, fintech, digital brokerage, or high-growth financial-services environments.\n\n - Experience scaling reporting through automation, modern data tooling, and operational-control frameworks.\n\n - Experience in a Big Four or national accounting firm, or a comparable advisory environment.\n   \n   \n\n\nWHO YOU ARE:\n\n - You are a strategic, hands-on leader who can move between technical detail and enterprise-level priorities.\n\n - You bring sound judgment in ambiguous or evolving regulatory environments.\n\n - You are an experienced people leader who builds high-trust teams with clear expectations, direct feedback, strong development practices, and a healthy performance culture.\n\n - You care deeply about accuracy, client outcomes, resilience, and doing the right thing.\n\n - You simplify complex topics and create alignment across functions.\n\n\n\n\nWHY WEALTHSIMPLE?\n\n🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance\n\n📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business\n\n🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year\n\n✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year\n\n👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS\n\n🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.\n\n\n\n\nICYMI\n\nTechnology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.\n\n\n\nInclusion Statement: We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well.
